baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of travel in the land, looking, asking how, and naming the predecessors' consequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bodily motion opens an evidence-gathering procedure: terrain exposes remains, sight must become insight, and the observed terminal condition is traced back as the consequence of a prior course.

activation_trace.role: Literal movement and flow make travel the first operation in a causal inspection rather than mere relocation.
The literal lower realm beneath the sky supplies a shared, material field in which prior outcomes can be encountered.
Directing eye or insight toward something turns movement across terrain into apprehension and reflection.
The literal end and consequence make the visible ruin an outcome to be explained, not an isolated spectacle.
Thorough annihilation supplies the terminal state whose causes and repeatability the journey tests.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely asks whether its audience has traveled and noticed that earlier peoples were destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a disciplined inquiry: move through a material record, convert sight into causal understanding, and read ruin as the end generated by a course of action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain linking a manner of travel, the predecessors, their aftermath, and the final statement of likeness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Travel can mirror a manner or course; looking can compare equivalents; aftermath can be footprint, remnant, and succession. Likeness therefore remains productively ambiguous between repetition of a fate and reenactment of a predecessor's course by a successor.

activation_trace.role: A literal manner or habitual course lets physical travel double as inquiry into how a people conducted itself.
Matching one equivalent with another supplies the comparative operation linking predecessors to present counterparts.
The heel, what lies behind, and a track make the aftermath readable as a residual trail left by those before.
Succession of one thing after another makes the present audience a possible next term in the sequence.
Literal similarity keeps analogous punishments and analogous peoples simultaneously available.
Imitation and following a pattern make resemblance something enacted, not only something externally assigned.

changed_reading.before: The closing likeness means only that comparable punishments await later disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Two readings coexist: comparable outcomes can recur, and later people can become comparable successors by retracing a predecessor's manner; the verse does not yet force a choice between fate-likeness and actor-likeness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of total destruction and the plural of likeness at the close.
baseline_models.mechanism: The result is not only repeated but made exemplary: annihilation becomes a punitive precedent, a formulated case, and a warning-sign by which another case can be judged.

activation_trace.role: Complete destruction supplies the severe event that is converted into an exemplar.
Punitive exemplarity gives likeness the force of a sanction displayed to deter another repetition.
A formulated example turns a past event into a portable comparative model.
A lesson or sign makes the destroyed case communicative rather than merely final.

changed_reading.before: The final clause predicts more events numerically similar to the old destruction.
changed_reading.after: The old destruction is also an exemplary sanction: its repeatability lies in its function as a warning-case through which a current course is measured.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence opposes a path that can be traveled to deliberate diversion from that path, then repeatedly describes works as lost or made to fall away. Fixed feet provide the positive movement-image. Destruction in the focus can therefore include the collapse of intended projects before or alongside bodily and civic ruin.

activation_trace.role: Actual forward movement supplies the focus-side contrast to obstructing a traversable way.
Total ruin is re-read as the outer terminal form of an earlier loss of direction and efficacy.
Turning away and turning others aside supplies the blocking operation that opposes the focus journey.
An extended way meant to be traversed makes obstruction spatial and functional rather than merely attitudinal.
Literal loss of a thing makes works fail to arrive as durable achievements.
Purposive action identifies what is rendered ineffective when direction is blocked.
Strengthening something into stability supplies the counter-mechanism to collapse.
The literal foot localizes stability in the same bodily apparatus used for the focus journey.
Falling and decline make the voiding of works a collapse-image immediately before the focus ruin.

structural_cues: 47:1 opens with path-obstruction followed by loss of works, while 47:8-10 repeats lost or voided works immediately before the focus destruction.
47:7 fixes feet, creating a movement contrast with the travel-question at 47:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obstruction, a traversable path, lost works, fixed feet, and then destruction; I infer an arrow from blocked orientation to failed action to terminal collapse. A live alternative is that loss of works and destruction are parallel judgments rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports only the physical elimination of earlier peoples.
changed_reading.after: Their ruin can be read as a layered loss of direction, effective action, stability, and finally collective existence; the travel-question asks whether present action is actually reaching a sound end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel contrasts protective allegiance with its absence, then introduces a city stronger than the addressee's own city, its expulsion of him, its annihilation, and the absence of a helper. The remote aftermath becomes a current civic analogy in which concentrated strength and expulsion do not prevent support from collapsing.

activation_trace.role: The shared terrestrial field lets the focus ruins and the addressee's city occupy one comparable political geography.
Total annihilation supplies the focus endpoint that the stronger-city comparison makes locally imaginable.
Protective loyalty and aid supply the positive and explicitly absent support relation on the two sides of the contrast.
A gathered human settlement makes destruction civic and collective, not only individual.
Strength compounded like strands of a rope supplies the apparently robust capacity that nevertheless fails.
Passage to the outside gives expulsion a spatial role in the city's hostile course.
Falling into extinction supplies a direct contextual counterpart to the focus annihilation.
Aid that makes a party prevail is explicitly absent, completing the collapse of protective capacity.

structural_cues: 47:11 immediately follows the focus with an explanatory patronage contrast.
47:13 shifts from former peoples to a city stronger than 'your city,' then closes with no helper.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent protection, a stronger gathered city, expulsion, extinction, and no helper; I infer that civic support failure is part of how the focus destruction becomes a present analogy. The live alternative is a direct divine annihilation that does not imply an internal institutional process.

changed_reading.before: The destroyed predecessors are safely remote examples from an unspecified past.
changed_reading.after: The comparison reaches the addressee's own city: even concentrated civic strength can lose every protective relation, so expellers may become the next visible settlement in the land's record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same earth later becomes the arena in which turning away can produce corruption and sever kinship. The land inspected in the focus is therefore not a neutral museum: social actors make the traces that later travelers read, and present hearers can become producers of the next aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Literal earth first serves as the material archive across which prior consequences are inspected.
Annihilation supplies the kind of social-material trace that can be left for later inspection.
Turning away supplies the initiating reversal by which observers may become agents of corruption.
Departure from soundness gives the earth a process of degradation rather than only a finished ruin.
The repeated literal earth identifies the focus evidence-field with the arena of present action.
Severing connection supplies the social fragmentation that can materialize as collective breakdown.
Womb-based kinship names the connective tissue being cut in the proposed breakdown.

structural_cues: 47:22 repeats 'in the earth' while shifting the audience from travelers who inspect consequences to possible agents who cause corruption.
Corruption and severed kinship are coordinated in one prospective construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated earth, turning away, corruption, and severed kinship; I infer an arrow from social disconnection to the material aftermath later read as ruin. A live alternative is that these are co-listed offenses without a claim that one physically produces the destroyed landscape.

changed_reading.before: Travelers stand outside history and inspect ruins made by wholly other people.
changed_reading.after: The question is self-implicating: the audience acts on the same earth it reads, and its own corruption and severance could manufacture the next archive of aftermath.

context_deltas.mechanism: Aftermath and the rear share a directional field. The context distinguishes beneficial rearward thought, which considers how an affair ends, from destructive backward motion, which turns away after guidance; the later face-and-back scene closes that directional circuit.

activation_trace.role: Eye and insight provide the capacity by which looking backward in history can become reflective rather than regressive.
Heel, rear, and residual track give the focus aftermath a backward-facing spatial edge.
The end produced by an act makes rearward attention an inquiry into consequence.
Insight of the heart shows that the relevant blindness can persist despite intact access to visible evidence.
Managing an affair by looking into its consequence supplies the positive form of rearward cognition.
Apostate reversal supplies the negative transformation of looking back into going back.
Showing the back in withdrawal makes rejection a bodily direction opposed to reflection on outcomes.
The face as front and future supplies the forward pole of the final directional contrast.
The literal back supplies the rear pole on which the consequence lands.

structural_cues: 47:24-25 juxtaposes pondering with people who reverse onto their backs after guidance becomes clear.
The branchless K-Y-F question recurs at 47:27, where faces and backs make direction explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aftermath, rearward deliberation, reversal onto backs, blindness of insight, and a face-back closure; I infer a contrast between cognitively looking back and normatively moving back. The live alternative is that these repeated rear terms serve separate local scenes without a deliberate directional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Looking at a past outcome and turning backward are unrelated actions.
changed_reading.after: The focus tests whether one can look backward historically without moving backward ethically: aftermath should orient the face forward, while refusal converts the same rearward axis into retreat and its consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from concealed rancor to divinely enabled showing, recognition by marks, recognition through inflected speech, and tests that expose inward reports. The focus gaze can thus be a forensic method: visible remains are one instance of inferring a hidden trajectory from outward signs.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or insight supplies the focus method that is extended from terrain to living signs.
A thing's appearance to its viewer makes the exterior a legible surface rather than the whole reality.
Causing something to be seen supplies the disclosure that brings a concealed group into the diagnostic field.
Recognition by an effect or sign provides the inference from surface evidence to identity.
A visible mark from which a viewer reads condition supplies the nonverbal diagnostic channel.
The slant of speech toward an implied sense supplies an auditory sign of what remains unstated.
Testing that makes a condition appear turns time and pressure into instruments of disclosure.
Knowledge of a report and an affair's interior names the hidden state that testing exposes.

structural_cues: 47:29-31 forms a reveal sequence: hidden rancor, marks and tonal cues, then testing of reports.
The shift from ruined landscapes to living speakers preserves the focus requirement that observation become interpretation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, showing, marks, tonal implication, testing, and inward report; I infer that the focus landscape-reading is one case of a broader sign-to-trajectory method. A live alternative is that the later signs identify present hypocrisy without licensing prediction of the same worldly destruction.

changed_reading.before: The command to look concerns only conspicuous ruins whose meaning is already obvious.
changed_reading.after: The command trains diagnostic attention: infer concealed orientation from material, bodily, verbal, and temporal traces, while admitting that recognition of a trajectory is not identical to foreknowing its exact outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: An early context use frames examples around following falsehood or truth; the final context use makes turning away lead to replacement by another people who will explicitly not be like the present audience. These bookends make resemblance behavioral and conditional: succession can repeat a pattern, but replacement can also break it.

activation_trace.role: Succession of one term after another provides the temporal frame in which likeness may repeat or be interrupted.
Literal similarity keeps both comparable peoples and comparable outcomes available in the focus.
Imitating a pattern supplies the behavioral mechanism by which a later people becomes similar.
Following in another's wake links the two contrasted groups to chosen trajectories before examples are stated.
A formulated example turns opposed patterns of following into comparative models for people.
Turning away supplies the condition that initiates replacement rather than an unavoidable cycle.
One entity standing in another's place makes succession explicit while allowing changed character.
A human collectivity identifies the replacement term as another people, not merely another event.
Difference and otherness prevent replacement from collapsing into identical recurrence.
Explicitly negated similarity proves that a successor need not reproduce the displaced people's pattern.

structural_cues: 47:3 places examples immediately after a falsehood-truth contrast organized by following.
47:38 closes the surah with the conditional sequence turning away, replacement, otherness, and 'not your likes.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies behaviorally contrasted following, the focus likeness, and a conditional replacement that ends in explicit non-likeness; I read the final contrast back onto the focus as evidence that resemblance is acquired and breakable. A live alternative is that the focus likeness refers only to punishments, whereas 47:38 compares peoples.

changed_reading.before: The focus announces a deterministic cycle in which every successor is another copy and receives an identical fate.
changed_reading.after: Recurrence is conditional: following a predecessor's pattern can make a later group and its outcome analogous, but another successor can occupy the same place without being alike, so history supplies a warning rather than an inescapable script.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a remote destructive-gaze idiom through 47:20's death-marked look. It remains valid because the repeated N-Z-R occurrence and focus annihilation visibly anchor the reversal. Downstream prose should present it as exploratory wordplay about who becomes visible, not as the ordinary lexical sense of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus look-command at word 5 beside annihilation at word 12.

activation_trace.role: An idiom in which time's glance strikes a people with ruin gives looking a remote destructive resonance.
Complete annihilation keeps that remote gaze resonance attached to the focus outcome.
Seeing with eye or insight reverses the observational frame by making the reluctant lookers themselves visible.
The repeated gaze likened locally to proximity to death activates the otherwise distant destructive-gaze branch.

changed_reading.before: The audience looks outward at already destroyed others.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, refusal of the historical look folds the gaze back: living resistors become visible through a death-marked look as previews of the aftermath they decline to read.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it draws on the branch in which an earth-associated creature consumes wood, far from the verse's ordinary land sense. It remains anchored by the focus earth and annihilation and by 47:22's corruption and severed kinship. Render it only as a material analogy for hidden social erosion becoming visible collapse, never as a claim that the focus word lexically denotes the creature.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The land at word 4 as the site of remains, joined to total destruction at word 12.

activation_trace.role: Hidden consumption of timber supplies a material analogy for supports being eaten away before collapse is visible on the land.
Annihilation is the eventual visible state to which concealed corrosion is tentatively directed.
Departure from soundness provides the contextual process of internal deterioration.
Severed connection names the loss of social binding that the material analogy treats as structural weakening.
Kinship derived from the womb identifies the living bond whose erosion is hidden before collective rupture.

changed_reading.before: Destruction arrives as an abrupt external event and leaves ruins.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the final collapse may expose a long concealed corrosion of connective supports; the land records the late visible phase of an inward social failure.

strongest_changes: Path language turns travel into an ethical movement contrast: obstructed direction can erase purposive action before collective collapse becomes visible.
The rearward cluster distinguishes reflection on aftermath from retreat onto one's back, so historical looking is meant to orient future action.
Marks, tonal inflection, and testing extend the focus gaze from ruined landscapes to diagnostic reading of concealed living trajectories.
The opening and closing uses of likeness make recurrence behavioral and conditional; replacement by a people who are not alike proves the pattern can be broken.
summary.what_was_special: The context did not settle the focus into one historical moral. It made the same compact sequence support material archaeology, collapse of projects and protection, self-produced ruins, directional cognition, forensic sign-reading, and a non-deterministic theory of resemblance, while two branch-distant images remained live under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The closing pronoun in the focus can still point toward analogous destructions, analogous outcomes, or analogous peoples; the branch evidence preserves rather than resolves that ambiguity.
Loss of works, civic support failure, and physical annihilation may be stages of one mechanism or parallel dimensions of judgment.
The death-gaze and hidden-corrosion outliers are useful only as qualified activations and should not displace the ordinary travel, sight, land, consequence, and annihilation senses.
